At native and enlarged views each figure has one head, two arms, two hands, two legs and two feet; visible hands show five digits and each of four bare feet shows five toes. rows.scene: One connected tree holds both dream and waking; the reclining figure now has two clearly separated arms, with the second hand visible on the thigh.
rows.candidate_status: One generic reclining figure rests on the connected dream/waking tree with the existing mango cluster and waking-side lotus. The forehead is bare, with no tilak or paint; no earrings, necklaces, armlets or bangles are visible, and the figure wears plain dark hair in a simple topknot. Native and enlarged views show exactly two attached arms from distinct shoulders: one bends to support the head, the other runs separately along the side to a clearly visible thigh-resting hand; the forearms do not overlap or merge. The thigh hand shows a thumb and four fingers; the head-support hand shows four fingers, with its thumb partly occluded by head contact. One head, two connected legs, two feet, and five toes on each foot. Skin-only 11x11 medians: cheek origin (238,388) RGB (162,77,38), R-B 124; torso origin (360,454) RGB (115,46,19), R-B 96. The cheek sample is 4 above the plan guide; both patches read as warm brown, not orange. No second person, text, logo, watermark, rays or obvious artifact. Producer-reviewed pass with the measured cheek deviation disclosed; fresh independent exact-checksum review pending; art remains unapproved.
